title.zh: Cu Barrier、Seed和电镀必须连续衔接
title.en: Cu barrier, seed and electroplating require continuous interfaces

subtitle.zh: Dual Damascene不是单层沉积，而是一条连续界面链
subtitle.en: Dual damascene is a continuous interface chain, not a single deposition

body.zh: Via / Trench；刻蚀形成互连结构；Low-k；介质
body.en: Via / trench Etch the interconnect structure Low-k Dielectric

body.zh: Clean / Pre-clean；去残留，活化底部与侧壁
body.en: Clean / pre-clean Remove residues and activate the bottom and sidewalls

body.zh: TaN / Ta；先阻挡Cu扩散，再衔接Seed界面；TaN；（阻挡层）；Ta；（衔接层）
body.en: TaN / Ta Block Cu diffusion first, then prepare the seed interface TaN (barrier layer) Ta (transition layer)

body.zh: Cu Seed；建立连续导电种子层；Cu Seed；（种子层）
body.en: Cu seed Establish a continuous conductive seed layer Cu seed (seed layer)

body.zh: ECP Cu + Anneal；电镀填充，再稳定晶粒与应力
body.en: ECP Cu + anneal Electroplate the fill, then stabilize grains and stress

body.zh: CMP + Cap；去除场区Cu，并封住互连顶部
body.en: CMP + cap Remove field Cu and seal the interconnect top

body.zh: Low-k介质；TaN（阻挡层）；Ta（衔接层）；Cu Seed（种子层）；ECP Cu（电镀铜）
body.en: Low-k dielectric TaN (barrier layer) Ta (transition layer) Cu seed (seed layer) ECP Cu (electroplated Cu)
Continuous barrier Barrier break: Cu may diffuse outward

body.zh: Seed连续；断种：局部无法起镀
body.en: Continuous seed Seed break: local plating cannot start
ECP fillability Fill failure: a void or seam forms

body.zh: 任何一环断开，最终都可能表现成高电阻或可靠性失效
body.en: A break anywhere in the chain can ultimately cause high resistance or reliability failure
